content:
Last week, a number of current Apple products saw unusually steep discounts, ranging from 25% off the AirPods Pro 3 to $120 off the latest AirPods Max 2, but the deals aren't over yet. While those discounts are still active, Amazon has just dropped the price of Apple's 2026 AirTag 2 to an all-time low — as little as $20 per unit.

During last week's anniversary sales, we reported several times on the next-generation AirTag 2 hitting new historical lows, and if you missed out there's no need to worry — the price has now dropped even further, setting the best deal we've ever tracked.

Amazon still has the single AirTag 2 on sale at $24 — matching the lowest price we've seen since launch — but the 4-pack has been reduced to $79.99 with free shipping.

Apple's official 4-pack is priced at $99, which is already better value than the regular $29 per unit, and now it's going for nearly 20% off, setting a new historical low at just $20 per AirTag 2.

While the previous 4-pack deal at $90 is likely to hold across major retailers throughout their anniversary sales, Amazon's new all-time low is a different story — nobody knows when the price will go back up.

We've previously compared the original AirTag with this year's AirTag 2 — you can check it out here — here's a summary of the highlights:

  • Precision Finding range extended up to 1.5x further
  • Volume up to 50% louder than the previous generation
  • AirTag 2 can be heard from up to twice the distance
  • New "industry-first suite of anti-stalking protection features"

AirTag 2 new features coming soon

The AirTag 2 at $20 each is a deal ahead of the launch of iOS 27 and watchOS 27, both due out next month. For Apple Watch users, there's good news: the Find My app has gained Precision Finding support. That means you can now use your Apple Watch with on-screen arrows and specific distance information to locate your AirTag.

watchOS 27 also unifies the Find My experience into a single app. Previously, the Find My features on Apple Watch were split into three separate app icons in the App List or Home Screen, corresponding to People, Items, and Devices.

On the other hand, iOS 27 introduces a new design and interface changes to the Find My app, making it easier to track people and items.

All things considered, now is absolutely a great time to expand your AirTag 2 collection — especially at this price.

  • AirPods Max 2 — $429 (was $549)
  • AirPods Pro 3 — $190 (was $249)
  • AirPods 4 — $99 (was $129)
